name: cellular communication network factor 6

function.text: CCN6 encodes cellular communication network factor 6. Annotated molecular activities include heparin binding and integrin binding. It participates in signal transduction and cell adhesion.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to progressive pseudorheumatoid arthropathy of childhood (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
